truth_boundary: Audit evidence only. This artifact does not schedule work, mint authority, or create a successor claim.

findings.finding: closeCampaign returns status CONTINUE with continuity_request when campaign requirements remain unsatisfied, and explicitly labels that output CONTINUITY_REQUEST_ONLY_NO_SCHEDULING_OR_PROMOTION_AUTHORITY.

materialize-return-fanin-judge-closer persists FANIN, VERDICT, CLOSE and PRIMARY_CHAT_PROJECTION, but performs no allocation reentry, successor materialization, or atomic claim attempt from continuity_request.

multi-stage-worker-continuation can evaluate and atomically CREATE a successor claim only after receiving a successor object with opportunity_id/readiness/context/authority; it has no adapter from campaign continuity_request lane IDs to that successor contract.

required_reentry_contract.input: campaign close status CONTINUE + continuity_request lane IDs + durable fan-in/verdict refs
required_reentry_contract.adapter: resolve requested lanes into existing claimable CURRENT work without inventing a scheduler or new authority
required_reentry_contract.output: ordinary allocator-visible work or an existing successor opportunity contract with preserved context/authority/readiness evidence
required_reentry_contract.claim: existing atomic CREATE authority path only
required_reentry_contract.failure: durable boundary if mapping cannot be proven; never silently mark campaign active

regression_expectations: PASS close creates no successor work
durable-boundary close creates no successor work
CONTINUE close cannot be considered reentered merely because PRIMARY_CHAT_PROJECTION exists
CONTINUE reentry must end in existing allocator-visible work or an atomic successor-claim attempt
no worker-specific routing or parallel scheduler is introduced
